description: What used a calendar month's allowance (period=YYYY-MM, default this month; not the billing period): billed seconds and tokens per standard test, mission test, mapping job, load test and Quinn, largest first, at most 20, each with its id and name where they can be found (null otherwise). otherSources counts the sources left out. Mission testing is not itemised per test today and shows as one mission_test row with no id. Use when: someone asks which tests or maps used their minutes. Owner or billing admin only; other roles get 403. Only a person signed in to the nopaque web app can call this; an API key is refused.

period.description: The month, YYYY-MM (UTC). Default is the current month.

name: getUsageBySource

outputSchema.description:
What used this calendar month's allowance: billed seconds and tokens
per test, mission test, mapping job, load test and Quinn, largest
first, at most 20. `otherSources` counts the sources left out.

id.description: The test config, mission test config, mapping job or load test id; null for quinn, other and unitemised mission testing.

name.description: Its name, or null when it cannot be named.

title: Get What Used the Allowance
